description: Internal header for PKCS#8 cryptographic functions in OpenSSL, including key decryption, encryption, and key derivation functions.

classes.name: pkcs8_priv_key_info_st
classes.description: Structure holding PKCS#8 private key information, including version, algorithm, key data, and attributes.

classes.name: pbe_suite
classes.description: Structure defining parameters for password-based encryption schemes, including NID, OID, cipher and digest functions, and initialization function.

methods.name: pkcs8_pbe_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts data using a specified PBE scheme, outputting decrypted data buffer.

methods.name: pkcs12_key_gen
methods.description: Generates key material using PKCS#12 key derivation function as per RFC 7292.

methods.name: pkcs12_pbe_encrypt_init
methods.description: Initializes encryption context for PKCS#12 PBE encryption, outputs AlgorithmIdentifier.

methods.name: PKCS5_pbe2_decrypt_init
methods.description: Initializes decryption context for PKCS#5 PBES2 scheme.

methods.name: PKCS5_pbe2_encrypt_init
methods.description: Configures encryption context for PKCS#5 PBES2 scheme, outputs AlgorithmIdentifier.

methods.name: pkcs12_iterations_acceptable
methods.description: Checks if the number of iterations is reasonable for PBKDF2.
